name: Triton H 66
description: Triton H 66 (CAS 37281-48-4 ) is an anionic surfactant used across industrial formulation and process chemistry. It delivers effective emulsification, dispersion, and degreasing performance in demanding aqueous systems. In textile and leather processing, it functions as a wetting and scouring agent, improving penetration of treatment baths and ensuring uniform fiber or hide processing. This ensures high-quality results in manufacturing. Industrial and institutional cleaning formulations use it to emulsify oils and lift soils from hard surfaces, equipment, and process lines. It is highly effective for heavy-duty degreasing and maintenance tasks. Coatings and adhesive manufacturers incorporate it as a dispersant to stabilize pigment and filler suspensions. This improves product consistency and shelf stability for long-term storage and application. In paper manufacturing, it supports sizing and surface treatment processes where controlled wetting and dispersion are critical to sheet quality. It helps maintain uniformity across large production runs. Triton H 66 is typically supplied as a liquid, suited for direct incorporation into aqueous formulations or dilution into process baths. This allows for easy handling and precise dosing in industrial settings. It is available in technical grade, the standard specification for industrial cleaning, textile, and coatings applications. This grade meets the rigorous requirements of most large-scale chemical processes. Bulk supply is common in drums and IBC containers, with packaging options aligned to industrial procurement volumes.
